courses.text: Amuse bouche with something else in it. wow!
Tomato sourdough toast with fondue and tomato xo
Albacore crudo with rosemary tonnato sauce and amazing tender green and white beans and crunches soo interesting, rosemary brings it all together
Halibut with corn broth, gnocchi, chanterelles - wonderful corn butter sauce, spicy
Lamb barbacoa with fig leaf powder, yogurt, odd cannelini beans
